info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Business Unit Financial Analysis API
info.description: The Business Unit Financial Analysis API provides detailed financial insights for specific business units within an organization. Utilizing the endpoint, users can retrieve comprehensive data regarding revenue, expenses, and profitability metrics to facilitate informed decision-making. This API is particularly beneficial for financial analysts, business managers, and stakeholders seeking to assess financial performance and make strategic business decisions. By offering valuable analytics, it empowers organizations to optimize their financial operations and enhance overall performance.

get.summary: Retrieve financial analysis for a business unit.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the financial analysis data related to a specific business unit. It provides detailed insights necessary for business evaluations and decision-making.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve financial analysis data for a specific business unit, identified by RES-100045. It expects a JSON input structure that aligns with the defined schema.

200.description: Successfully retrieved business unit financial analysis data.
